title: Blinded Human Annotation Record Schema
description: Validation schema for individual human annotator entries in the LLM Uncertainty Classification Benchmark (Milestone 7).

blinded_id.description: Blinded pseudo-random question identifier isolating annotator from gold labels and question metadata.

question.description: The exact natural language query presented to the annotator.

assigned_label.description: The epistemic uncertainty label assigned by the annotator under the annotation rubric.

confidence.description: The annotator's subjective certainty in their label assignment.

rationale.description: Concise justification for the assigned label, citing epistemic criteria from the rubric.

requires_adjudication.description: Flag indicating if the annotator found the item borderline or ambiguous between rubric classes.

notes.description: Optional notes on phrasing, domain specificity, or potential interpretations.
